_README: Tool schemas of the Study 3 harness (study3/src6/world6.py, frozen) for locks_s2text and locks; Study 4's locks_s2text and locks must match them byte for byte (src7/tests7.py).

locks.description: Read a record. Returns its current value. While the record is locked under a lease you do not hold, also returns locked: true.
locks.name: get_record

fencing_token.description: The fencing_token returned by acquire_lock. Required while the record is locked. A write whose token's lease has ended is rejected with 409.

value.description: New value: integer stock, decimal string for money, holder name or null.

locks.description: Set the holder of a seat or ticket record (holder defaults to your agent id).

fencing_token.description: The fencing_token returned by acquire_lock. Required while the record is locked. A write whose token's lease has ended is rejected with 409.

locks.name: claim

locks.description: List the writes you have committed, optionally for one record.
locks.name: list_effects

locks.description: Take an exclusive lock on a record. Acquire the lock before you read a record you will update, and lock every record your decision depends on: the records your condition reads as well as the ones you write. A value you read before the lock was granted may be out of date. The lease covers your next lease_calls tool calls (1-20): every tool call you make after this one, of any kind and on any record, uses one unit; time between your calls does not count. Returns fencing_token and lease_remaining. While the lock is held, writes to the record are accepted only if they carry this fencing_token (writes without it get 423). When the lease runs out or you release it, the lock ends and the token stops working. If the record is already locked, the call waits up to 150 rounds (a round is one scheduling step) for it to be released, then returns 423; a call that waited says so in its response (waited_rounds).

lease_calls.description: Lease length in your own tool calls (1-20).

locks.name: acquire_lock

locks.description: Restart the lease of a lock you still hold so it covers your next lease_calls tool calls (1-20). Returns the same fencing_token and lease_remaining. Fails with 409 if you no longer hold the lock.

lease_calls.description: Lease length in your own tool calls (1-20).

locks.name: renew_lock
